articles.abstract_en: We provide experimental evidence of a positive memory bias that affects individuals’ beliefs, decisions to reinvest, and overconfidence in the stock market. Individuals overremember positive investment outcomes of chosen assets and underremember negative ones. Based on their memories, subjects form overly optimistic beliefs about their investment, reinvest too much, and become overconfident about their investment ability relative to others. We further provide evidence on motivation driving the memory bias. This positive memory bias offers a cognitive microfoundation for why gains weight more than losses when people learn from experiences. This helps reconcile various stylized facts in investor beliefs and behavior.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提供了关于积极记忆偏差的实验证据，这种偏差影响个体的信念、再投资决策以及股票市场中的过度自信。个体过度记住所选资产的积极投资结果，而低估消极结果。基于他们的记忆，受试者对自己的投资形成过度乐观的信念，过度再投资，并相对于他人对自己的投资能力变得过度自信。我们进一步提供了驱动记忆偏差的动机证据。这种积极记忆偏差为人们在从经验中学习时，收益比损失权重更大提供了认知微观基础。这有助于调和投资者信念和行为中的各种典型化事实。

articles.abstract_en: I show that memory-induced attention can distort prices in financial markets. I exploit rigid earnings announcement schedules to identify which firms are associated in investors’ memory. Firms with randomly overlapping earnings announcements are associated in memory because many investors experience them in the same context. Months later, when only one of the two firms announces earnings, this context is cued, and triggers the recall of the other, associated firm. On such days, I find that memory-induced attention leads to buying pressure in the associated firm’s stock. The strength of this effect varies as predicted by associative memory theory.
articles.abstract_cn: 我展示了记忆引发的注意力可以扭曲金融市场中的价格。我利用固定的盈利公告时间表来识别哪些公司在投资者的记忆中被关联起来。由于许多投资者在相同背景下经历这些公司，因此盈利公告时间随机重叠的公司会在记忆中被关联。几个月后，当这两家公司中只有一家发布盈利公告时，这一背景被提示，并触发对另一家关联公司的回忆。在这样的日子里，我发现记忆引发的注意力会导致关联公司股票出现买入压力。这种效应的强度随联想记忆理论的预测而变化。

articles.title_en: Return Predictability, Expectations, and Investment: Experimental Evidence
articles.title_cn: 收益可预测性、预期与投资：实验证据
articles.abstract_en: In an investment experiment, we show variations in information affect beliefs and decision-making within the information-beliefs-decisions chain. Subjects observe the time series of a risky asset and a signal that, in random rounds, helps predict returns. Subjects form extrapolative forecasts following a signal they perceive as useless, and their investment decisions underreact to their beliefs. If the same subjects perceive the signal as predictive, they rationally use it in their forecasts, they no longer extrapolate, and they rely significantly more on their forecasts when making risk allocations. Analyzing investments without observing forecasts and information sets leads to erroneous interpretations.
articles.abstract_cn: 在一项投资实验中，我们展示了信息变化如何影响信息-信念-决策链条中的信念和决策制定。受试者观察一种风险资产的时间序列以及一个信号，该信号在随机轮次中有助于预测收益。受试者根据他们认为无用的信号形成外推性预测，而他们的投资决策对其信念反应不足。如果同一批受试者认为该信号具有预测性，他们会在预测中理性地使用它，不再进行外推，并且在做出风险配置时显著更多地依赖其预测。在不观察预测和信息集的情况下分析投资会导致错误的解释。

articles.title_en: Earnings Extrapolation and Predictable Stock Market Returns
articles.title_cn: 盈利外推与可预测的股票市场回报
articles.abstract_en: The U.S. stock market’s return during the first month of a quarter correlates strongly with returns in future months, but the correlation is negative if the future month is the first month of a quarter, and positive if it isn’t. These correlations offset, consistent with the well-known near-zero unconditional autocorrelation, yet they are pervasive, present across industries and countries. The pattern accords with a model in which investors extrapolate announced earnings to predict future earnings, not recognizing that earnings in the first month of a quarter are discretely less predictable than in prior months. Survey data support the model.
articles.abstract_cn: 美国股市在季度首月的回报与未来月份的回报强相关，但如果未来月份是季度首月，则相关性为负，如果不是，则为正。这些相关性相互抵消，与众所周知的接近零的无条件自相关一致，但它们普遍存在，跨行业和国家均如此。该模式符合一个模型，其中投资者外推已公布的盈利以预测未来盈利，未认识到季度首月的盈利可预测性明显低于前几个月。调查数据支持该模型。

articles.title_en: Can Equity Option Returns Be Explained by a Factor Model? IPCA Says Yes
articles.title_cn: 期权收益能否用因子模型解释？IPCA表示可以
articles.abstract_en: A number of delta-hedged equity option strategies exhibit very large average returns. We show that much of the profitability of these strategies can be explained by an IPCA factor model. The economic magnitude of the return-adjustment produced by IPCA is impressive: even before transaction costs, the average IPCA alpha of 46 long-short trading strategies constructed on previously discovered signals, is close to zero and contrasts with average realized returns of over 80 basis points per month. Our IPCA model can be used as a benchmark for assessing the performance of other option portfolios.
articles.abstract_cn: 许多delta对冲的股票期权策略表现出非常大的平均收益。我们表明，这些策略的大部分盈利能力可以用IPCA因子模型来解释。IPCA产生的收益调整的经济规模令人印象深刻：即使在交易成本之前，基于先前发现的信号构建的46个多空交易策略的平均IPCA alpha接近于零，而平均已实现收益每月超过80个基点。我们的IPCA模型可以作为评估其他期权组合表现的基准。

articles.title_en: Common Pricing of Decentralized Risk: A Linear Option Pricing Model
articles.title_cn: 分散化风险的统一定价：一个线性期权定价模型
articles.abstract_en: This paper proposes a top-down linear option pricing model that unifies the pricing of different option contracts not by assuming common dynamics but by imposing common pricing on each risk source in proportion to decentralized risk estimates. The model generates significantly better pricing performance than existing bottom-up models. Its high-dimensional risk structure effectively explains the options return variation, allowing for the seamless integration of option pricing with risk management. The market price of risk estimate from the model strongly predicts the future excess return of the corresponding risk-targeting option portfolio, an important dimension of attribute completely absent from prior literature.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一个自上而下的线性期权定价模型，该模型并非通过假设共同动态，而是通过对每个风险源施加与其分散化风险估计成比例的统一定价，来统一不同期权合约的定价。该模型产生的定价性能显著优于现有的自下而上模型。其高维风险结构有效解释了期权收益的变动，使得期权定价与风险管理能够无缝整合。模型估计的风险市场价格强烈预测了相应风险目标期权组合的未来超额收益，这是先前文献中完全缺失的一个重要属性维度。

articles.abstract_en: According to existing theories, short-term creditors promote corporate governance by responding quickly to new information. I show that this very feature of short-term debt can also undermine corporate governance. Though moderate levels of short-term debt improve the efficacy of blockholder exit and increase blockholders’ incentives to engage with the firm, high levels of short-term debt impair governance. In particular, high levels of short-term debt render the threat of exit noncredible, make public engagements too risky, and undermine blockholders’ incentives to engage behind the scenes. I identify a challenge in the governance of firms that rely on short-term funding such as banks.
articles.abstract_cn: 根据现有理论，短期债权人通过迅速响应新信息来促进公司治理。我表明，短期债务的这一特性也可能削弱公司治理。虽然适度的短期债务水平提高了大宗股东退出的效率，并增加了大宗股东与公司互动的激励，但高水平的短期债务会损害治理。特别是，高水平的短期债务使退出威胁不可信，使公开互动风险过高，并削弱了大宗股东在幕后互动的激励。我识别出依赖短期融资（如银行）的公司治理中的一个挑战。
